# Legacy Reference Analysis

Use this skill when working with the historical Applergic code as a reference source.

## Objectives

- Confirm what is recoverable from the legacy repository.
- Identify missing files and assumptions.
- Avoid reintroducing unproven logic into the modern project.

## Constraints

- Never modify files in the legacy repository.
- Treat it as read-only reference material.
- Distinguish between recovered behavior and reconstructed assumptions.

## Workflow

1. Inspect the legacy UI and logic.
2. Document observed behavior.
3. Identify required modern equivalents.
4. Implement only the proven minimum needed.
